description_en: Queries the list of access control lists (ACLs) for the DNS firewall
name: DescribeDnsFirewallPolicy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The language of the response messages. Valid values: zh (Chinese) and en (English)
parameters.help_zh: 请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：-zh：中文-en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the DNS firewall policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

The value of Source can be a CIDR block or an address book
parameters.help_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中的访问源地址。支持使用模糊查询。

Source可以是单个CIDR地址或地址簿名称
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the DNS firewall policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

The value of Destination can be a CIDR block, a domain name, or an address book
parameters.help_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址。支持模糊查询。

Destination可以是单个CIDR地址或域名，也可以是地址薄名称
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The description of the DNS firewall policy
parameters.help_zh: DNS边界防火墙策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The action that is performed on traffic that hits the DNS firewall policy. Valid values:

accept: allows the traffic.

drop: denies the traffic.

log: monitors the traffic.

If you do not specify this parameter, policies of all action types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中设置的访问流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察

不设置该参数表示查询所有动作
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en:
The status of the access control policy. The policy is enabled by default after it is created. Valid values:

true: enables the access control policy.

false: disables the access control policy
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略

false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the firewall rule
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙规则的唯一标识id
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The IP version that is supported. Valid values:

4: IPv4

6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。取值：

4：代表IPv4地址
6：代表IPv6地址
parameters.name: ip_version

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Policys.description_en: The DNS firewall access control policies
Policys.description_zh: DNS防火墙访问控制策略的信息

items.description_en: The DNS firewall access control policy
items.description_zh: DNS防火墙访问控制策略的信息

AclAction.description_en:
The action that is performed on traffic that matches the access control policy. Valid values:

accept: allows the traffic.

drop: denies the traffic.

log: monitors the traffic
AclAction.description_zh:
访问控制策略中设置的流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察

AclUuid.description_en: The unique ID of the access control policy
AclUuid.description_zh: 访问控制策略的唯一标识id

Description.description_en: The description of the access control policy
Description.description_zh: DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略的描述信息

Destination.description_en:
The destination address in the access control policy. Valid values:

If DestinationType is `net`, the value of this parameter is a destination CIDR block.

If DestinationType is `domain`, the value of this parameter is a destination domain.

If DestinationType is `group`, the value of this parameter is the name of a destination address book
Destination.description_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址。取值：

当DestinationType为`net`时，Destination为目的CIDR地址。

当DestinationType为`domain`时，Destination为目的域名。

当DestinationType为`group`时，Destination为目的地址簿名称

DestinationAddrs.description_en: The destination addresses in the address book
DestinationAddrs.description_zh: 目的地址簿的地址列表

items.description_en: The destination addresses in the address book
items.description_zh: 目的地址簿的地址列表

DestinationGroupType.description_en:
The type of the destination address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: an IP address book

domain: a domain address book
DestinationGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。
domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址

DestinationType.description_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block

group: destination address book

domain: destination domain

location: destination location
DestinationType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
location：目的区域

Direction.description_en:
The direction of the traffic to which the access control policy applies. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic

out: outbound traffic
Direction.description_zh:
访问控制策略的流量方向。取值：

in：外对内流量访问控制
out：内对外流量访问控制

HitLastTime.description_en: The last time the policy was hit. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
HitLastTime.description_zh: 最新命中时间戳。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

HitTimes.description_en: The number of hits for the access control policy
HitTimes.description_zh: 访问控制策略的命中次数

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP version supported by the access control policy. Valid values:

4: IPv4

6: IPv6
IpVersion.description_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。取值：

4：代表IPv4地址
6：代表IPv6地址

Priority.description_en: The priority of the access control policy. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 访问控制策略优先级。数字越小，优先级越高

Release.description_en:
Indicates whether the access control policy is enabled. After a policy is created, it is enabled by default. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled
Release.description_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略

false：不启用访问控制策略

Source.description_en:
The source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

If SourceType is `net`, the value of this parameter is a source CIDR block. Example: 192.0.XX.XX/24.

If SourceType is `group`, the value of this parameter is the name of a source address book. Example: db_group.

If SourceType is `location`, the value of this parameter is a location. For more information about the valid values of this parameter, see [AddControlPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138867.html）. Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
Source.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的访问源地址。取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，访问源为CIDR格式的IP地址段。例如：192.0.XX.XX/24。
当SourceType为`group`时，访问源地址为源地址簿名称。例如：db_group。
当SourceType为`location`时，访问源地址为区域（具体区域位置编码请参见[AddControlPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138867.html））。例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]

SourceGroupType.description_en:
The type of the source address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: an IP address book

tag: a tag address book

domain: a domain address book

threat: a threat intelligence address book

backsrc: a back-to-origin address book
SourceGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。

tag：ECS标签地址簿，包含一个或多个ECS标签下的IP地址。

domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址。

threat：威胁地址簿，包含一个或多个恶意IP或域名地址。

backsrc：回源地址簿，包含一个或多个DDoS防护实例或WAF实例的回源地址

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: a source CIDR block

group: a source address book
SourceType.description_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中源地址类型。取值：

net：源CIDR地址
group：源地址簿
